_doc: Fixture for checking the Wan2.1 umT5 relative-position bucket tables (packages/models/src/umt5/relative-position.ts).
Generated by tools/export-recipes/wan/umt5_host_fixture.py (the expected values are outputs of the upstream UMT5Attention._relative_position_bucket — that file's doc).
The tables have the orientation of the upstream compute_bias: table[i][j] = bucket(j − i) (key position − query position).
digest is the SHA-256 of the SHA-256s of the per-valid-length tables (i32 LE, row-major) chained in ascending order.
